name: punchlist-axi
description: Click-to-edit for any running web app: a proxy injects a picker, your coding agent pulls the batch of notes and edits the source.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p . && tsc -p src && tsc -p src/client && tsc -p test
scripts.check: pnpm run --silent typecheck && pnpm run --silent lint
scripts.test: node --import tsx test/cli.test.ts && node --import tsx test/proxy.test.ts && node --import tsx test/client.test.ts && node --import tsx test/drag.test.ts && node --import tsx test/ports.test.ts
